EnableDistanceCulling.title: Enable Distance Culling
EnableDistanceCulling.tooltip: Only send your VR tracking to players within the activation distance. If disabled, tracking is sent to EVERY player that has this mod, which increases network usage.

ActivationDistance.title: Activation Distance (m)
ActivationDistance.tooltip: Players closer than this many meters start receiving your VR tracking.

HysteresisMargin.title: Hysteresis Margin (m)
HysteresisMargin.tooltip: Extra meters beyond the activation distance before a player stops receiving your VR tracking. Prevents flickering at the boundary.

TrackingUpdateRate.title: Tracking Update Rate (Hz)
TrackingUpdateRate.tooltip: Maximum tracking updates sent per second. Lower values use less bandwidth.

EnableAdaptiveUpdateRate.title: Adaptive Update Rate
EnableAdaptiveUpdateRate.tooltip: Drop to the minimum update rate while your head and hands are moving slowly.

MinimumUpdateRate.title: Minimum Update Rate (Hz)
MinimumUpdateRate.tooltip: Update rate used during slow movement when the adaptive update rate is enabled. Never higher than the tracking update rate.

EnableDebugVisualization.title: [DEBUG] Tracking Markers
EnableDebugVisualization.tooltip: [DEBUG] Shows markers at the received head and hand positions of VR players.

EnableNetworkDiagnostics.title: [DEBUG] Network Diagnostics
EnableNetworkDiagnostics.tooltip: [DEBUG] Prints tracking network statistics to the console every 5 seconds.

DebugSimulateVR.title: [DEBUG] Simulate VR Poses
DebugSimulateVR.tooltip: [DEBUG] Sends synthetic head and hand poses without a headset, for testing without NomaiVR.
